params.message:
Draw every relation on Netwerk, sized and coloured by importance

The graph drew the 60 relations with the most projects and hid the rest
behind a "Hoeveel" picker. It now draws every relation in the period. A
dot grows with its projects, half again for high importance and a quarter
less for low, and the new default colouring is by importance (red high,
green medium, light green low, grey not yet set); colour by role or group
stays one click away. Shared projects are counted per project instead of
per pair of relations, so all of them draw quickly.
